whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Gemfile.lock no longer carries a Gemfile.lock with no `RUBY VERSION` section.
